newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines to stick to 1998 budget surplus target.
newsitem.headline: Philippines to stick to 1998 budget surplus target.

text.p: The Philippines still hopes to meet its projected budget surplus for next year despite changes in the macroeconomic outlook following this month's effective peso devaluation, Budget Secretary Salvador Enriquez said on Monday.
"We are still aiming at the 16 billion (peso) surplus next year," he told Reuters.
The proposed budget for 1998 is 541 billion pesos.
The government is predicting a smaller than originally expected budget surplus this year of seven billion pesos.
